answer: Invite-tree accounting gives every agent one parent who invited it, and each parent's own earnings are cut by the reward share its whole subtree loses when any descendant is caught as a sybil. A farm grafting N fake heads under one bridge account sees that account's penalty climb with each head, so it must spread fakes across many real, reputable inviters. Like basalt columns rising to a summit, a tall narrow branch stands out and is audited first.
